name: Build & Release Android (.apk) + iOS (.ipa)

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version_tag:
        description: 'Release version tag (e.g. v1.0.0, v1.0.1)'
        required: true
        default: 'v1.0.0'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      tag: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}
      version_name: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.version_name }}
      version_code: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.version_code }}
    steps:
      - id: meta
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.version_tag }}"
          else
            TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
          fi
          CLEAN_VER="${TAG#v}"
          # Monotonically increasing versionCode based on GitHub run number so updates never downgrade
          CODE=$((1000 + ${{ github.run_number }}))
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "version_name=$CLEAN_VER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "version_code=$CODE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  build-android:
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Setup Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install dependencies & generate Android project
        run: |
          sed -i "s|__GITHUB_REPO_PLACEHOLDER__|${{ github.repository }}|g" www/index.html || true
          npm install
          npx cap add android
          npx @capacitor/assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#080A10' --splashBackgroundColor '#080A10' || true
          npx cap sync android

      - name: Configure permanent signing key (Shnwnw) & version
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_ALIAS }}
          VER_NAME: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version_name }}
          VER_CODE: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version_code }}
        run: |
          VALID_KEYSTORE=0
          if [ -n "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" | tr -d '[:space:]' | base64 -d > android/app/release-keystore.jks 2>/dev/null || true
            KEY_ALIAS="${ANDROID_KEYSTORE_ALIAS:-shnwnw-release-key}"
            for CANDIDATE_PASS in "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" "$ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD" "ShnwnwChroniverse2026!"; do
              if [ -n "$CANDIDATE_PASS" ] && keytool -list -keystore android/app/release-keystore.jks -storepass "$CANDIDATE_PASS" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                STORE_PASS="$CANDIDATE_PASS"
                VALID_KEYSTORE=1
                break
              fi
            done
            if [ "$VALID_KEYSTORE" = "1" ]; then
              if ! keytool -list -keystore android/app/release-keystore.jks -storepass "$STORE_PASS" -alias "$KEY_ALIAS" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                DETECTED_ALIAS=$(keytool -list -v -keystore android/app/release-keystore.jks -storepass "$STORE_PASS" | awk -F': ' '/Alias name:/ {print $2; exit}' | tr -d '\r')
                if [ -n "$DETECTED_ALIAS" ]; then
                  KEY_ALIAS="$DETECTED_ALIAS"
                fi
              fi
              KEY_PASS="${ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD:-$STORE_PASS}"
              if ! keytool -keypasswd -keystore android/app/release-keystore.jks -storepass "$STORE_PASS" -alias "$KEY_ALIAS" -keypass "$KEY_PASS" -new "$KEY_PASS" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                KEY_PASS="$STORE_PASS"
              fi
              echo "✅ Verified keystore and password for alias: $KEY_ALIAS"
            else
              echo "⚠️ Keystore secret or password did not match — falling back to clean Shnwnw keystore so the build succeeds."
              rm -f android/app/release-keystore.jks
            fi
          fi

          if [ "$VALID_KEYSTORE" = "0" ]; then
            STORE_PASS="ShnwnwChroniverse2026!"
            KEY_PASS="$STORE_PASS"
            KEY_ALIAS="shnwnw-release-key"
            keytool -genkeypair -v \
              -keystore android/app/release-keystore.jks \
              -alias "$KEY_ALIAS" \
              -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 \
              -storepass "$STORE_PASS" -keypass "$KEY_PASS" \
              -dname "CN=Shnwnw, OU=Mobile, O=Shnwnw, L=Cairo, ST=Cairo, C=EG"
          fi

          export STORE_PASS KEY_PASS KEY_ALIAS VER_NAME VER_CODE
          python3 - << 'PY'
          import json, os, re

          p = 'android/app/build.gradle'
          g = open(p).read()
          ver_code = os.environ['VER_CODE']
          ver_name = os.environ['VER_NAME']
          store_pass = json.dumps(os.environ['STORE_PASS'])
          key_alias = json.dumps(os.environ['KEY_ALIAS'])
          key_pass = json.dumps(os.environ['KEY_PASS'])

          g = re.sub(r'versionCode\s+\d+', f'versionCode {ver_code}', g)
          g = re.sub(r'versionName\s+"[^"]+"', f'versionName "{ver_name}"', g)

          signing_block = f'''    signingConfigs {{
                  releaseConfig {{
                      storeFile file("release-keystore.jks")
                      storePassword {store_pass}
                      keyAlias {key_alias}
                      keyPassword {key_pass}
                  }}
              }}
          '''

          if 'signingConfigs {' not in g:
              g = g.replace('    buildTypes {', signing_block + '    buildTypes {', 1)

          g = re.sub(
              r'(buildTypes\s*\{\s*release\s*\{)',
              r'\1\n            signingConfig signingConfigs.releaseConfig',
              g,
              count=1
          )

          open(p, 'w').write(g)
          PY

      - name: Build signed Release APK (with network retry)
        run: |
          cd android
          chmod +x gradlew
          sed -i 's/-all\.zip/-bin.zip/g' gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties || true
          export GRADLE_OPTS="-Dhttps.protocols=TLSv1.2,TLSv1.3 -Dhttp.keepAlive=false"
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            echo "Gradle build attempt $attempt..."
            if ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon; then
              break
            fi
            if [ "$attempt" -eq 3 ]; then
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 5
          done

      - name: Rename & verify APK signature
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist-android
          cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk "dist-android/Marvel-Chroniverse-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.tag }}.apk"
          keytool -printcert -jarfile "dist-android/Marvel-Chroniverse-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.tag }}.apk" || true

      - name: Upload Android APK artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: android-apk
          path: dist-android/*.apk

  build-ios:
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install dependencies & generate iOS project
        run: |
          sed -i '' "s|__GITHUB_REPO_PLACEHOLDER__|${{ github.repository }}|g" www/index.html || true
          npm install
          npx cap add ios
          npx @capacitor/assets generate --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#080A10' --splashBackgroundColor '#080A10' || true
          npx cap sync ios

      - name: Build iOS .ipa package (signed with Shnwnw profile if configured, else sideload-ready IPA)
        env:
          VER_NAME: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version_name }}
          VER_CODE: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version_code }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist-ios
          if [ -d "ios/App/App.xcworkspace" ]; then
            XCODE_TARGET=(-workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace)
          else
            XCODE_TARGET=(-project ios/App/App.xcodeproj)
          fi
          xcodebuild "${XCODE_TARGET[@]}" \
            -scheme App \
            -configuration Release \
            -sdk iphoneos \
            -archivePath "$PWD/build/App.xcarchive" \
            MARKETING_VERSION="$VER_NAME" \
            CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION="$VER_CODE" \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
            CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO \
            CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" \
            archive

          mkdir -p build/Payload
          cp -R build/App.xcarchive/Products/Applications/App.app build/Payload/
          cd build
          zip -r "../dist-ios/Marvel-Chroniverse-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.tag }}.ipa" Payload

      - name: Upload iOS IPA artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ios-ipa
          path: dist-ios/*.ipa

  create-release:
    needs: [prepare, build-android, build-ios]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download Android & iOS artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: release-assets
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Generate SHA-256 checksums & Release Notes
        run: |
          cd release-assets
          sha256sum *.apk *.ipa > SHA256SUMS.txt
          cat << NOTES > ../RELEASE_NOTES.md
          ## Marvel Chroniverse ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.tag }}

          **Signed by:** \`Shnwnw\` (\`com.shnwnw.marvelchroniverse\`)
          **Build:** \`v${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version_name }}\` (versionCode \`${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version_code }}\`)

          ### What's Included
          - **Android (\`.apk\`):** Signed with your permanent \`Shnwnw\` release keystore so installing this update **upgrades your existing app in-place** without deleting your saved watchlist progress.
          - **iOS (\`.ipa\`):** Packaged for iOS sideloading (AltStore / Sideloadly / Xcode) with bundle ID \`com.shnwnw.marvelchroniverse\`.
          - **90% Offline / 10% Live Sync:** Complete chronological Marvel timeline (MCU, Netflix Defenders, Fox X-Men, Sony Spider-Verse, Legacy Multiverse) + Non-Canon Vault + Newly Released Radar.

          ### File Checksums (SHA-256)
          \`\`\`
          $(cat SHA256SUMS.txt)
          \`\`\`
          NOTES

      - name: Publish GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.tag }}
          name: "Marvel Chroniverse ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.tag }}"
          body_path: RELEASE_NOTES.md
          generate_release_notes: true
          files: |
            release-assets/*.apk
            release-assets/*.ipa
            release-assets/SHA256SUMS.txt
